_doc: Explicit hybrid adaptation of the imported Mindustry numbers (pinned v146, see mindustry_defs.json). Everything here is OUR decision, not upstream data; each section says what it adapts. The importer output is never edited.

ware_map._doc: Mindustry item -> hybrid inventory ware id. Coal is the same physical ware as the Widelands coal so a coal mine can feed a smelter. All other Mindustry items are new inventory wares (mdy.*), never new deposits.

block_sizes_note: Footprint sizes are upstream (Blocks.java size) in tiles; one hybrid tile is one Widelands node.
cost_note: S11: construction is paid in delivered Widelands goods. Conversion used to pick the numbers (then rounded by hand): copper->iron, lead->granite, silicon/titanium->iron, one plank per structural part, about one quarter of the Mindustry item count. Upstream requirements are kept in the registry as `source_cost` for comparison.

extraction._doc: Which wares an extractor can pull from the EXISTING Widelands deposit kinds (terrain res_kind). No new deposits exist: every rule reads the same reserve the Widelands mine reads. units_per_item = reserve units consumed per output item (the conversion factor); min_tier = the drill tier (Mindustry Drill.tier) needed. Extraction by the Widelands mine programme is unchanged.

sand.note: sand derives from existing desert/beach terrain; a floor drop has no finite reserve

units._doc: Mindustry unit -> an actor/weapon record in the shared combat rules (rules.HYBRID_ACTORS). hp and damage use OpenRA's internal scale (50 HP = 5000). Scales are adaptation: relative era strength is a tunable, recorded here.

dagger.label: Dagger
dagger.note: speed and range are hybrid values: upstream speed 0.5 px/tick (3.75 tiles/s) and bullet range 150 world units are in Mindustry tile units, not the RTS cell

crawler.label: Crawler
crawler.note: upstream crawler explodes on contact (no bullet damage in the weapon row); hybrid: a short-range charge every 24 ticks, damage from its 70-80 splash

nova.label: Nova
nova.note: speed and range are hybrid values in RTS cells (upstream 0.55 px/tick, laser bolt range ~ 150 world units)

power._doc: Upstream powerProduction/consumePower are per tick; the registry converts to per second. Adjacent power blocks share a graph (Block.connectedPower) and nodes link by laser within laserRange.
